scope: Round 2: two previously observed development mother instances; two new held-out mother instances (3 and 10-1). Fifty-customer subsets are nested, not independent replicates. Equal 5-second budgets throughout and additional 15 seconds for 100-customer B3. Descriptive engineering benchmark, no optimality or statistical significance claim.
selection_rule: Inspect development pilots only; freeze the chosen candidate before comparing any held-out results. Keep all trials. Prefer improving development mean distance without invalid solutions; explicitly report regressions and seed dispersion.
